skills.description:
★ 古诗背得滚瓜烂熟，一问「这句什么意思」就卡住——背了等于没背。

【你是不是也遇到过】
孩子背古诗很快，忘得更快。因为他是靠读音硬记的，根本不知道「举头望明月」在写什么画面。老师让说诗意，他背译文；让说感情，他说「思乡」——可问他从哪看出来，答不上。理解没到位，背多少遍都是短时记忆。

【它到底帮你做什么】
 1)  朗读节奏与停顿：五言、七言的划分规则，读对了才好背
 2)  字词释义方法：用注释、组词、看插图推，不是直接给译文
 3)  句意疏通与画面想象，把四句诗变成一幅画
 4)  情感体会引导：从哪个字看出情绪，不是空喊「思乡」
 5)  背诵方法：理解背、画面背、节奏背，不给现成文本照念
 6)  常见字词释义真实查表 + 朗读节奏实操规则

【谁最该用】
小学 1～6 年级孩子；尤其是「背了就忘」「不懂诗意硬背」的孩子；以及想帮孩子真正读懂古诗的家长。

【凭什么比别的好用】
 1)  顺序设计很专业：读准 → 懂字 → 想画面 → 再背。把理解放在记忆前面，这才背得牢。
 2)  不直接给整篇白话翻译，孩子自己推出来的意思才记得住。
 3)  五言七言的停顿规则给了具体划分法，朗读作业直接用得上。
 4)  常见字词释义做成查表，不依赖课本版本，换教材也能用。

【里面装了什么真料】
古诗文四维目标、朗读节奏与停顿、字词释义方法、句意疏通与画面想象、情感体会、背诵方法、常见易错点、启发话术库、示例引导、字词释义查表、节奏划分实操规则。

【一句话记住】
先懂再背，才背得住。

【什么情况别用它】
它不给整篇译文、不代写赏析。孩子要的是默写自查，用听写类技能。

skills.description: Turn your own list of old accounts into an executable cleanup plan - sorted into four tiers by exposure risk, with deletion order, pre-deletion prerequisites and a 30-day re-check ledger (digital footprint / account cleanup / delete old accounts / privacy cleanup / phone number leaked / spam from sites I don't remember / changing phone number / name shows up in search / remove my personal info / GDPR erasure). Use when the user says "I have way too many accounts, where do I even start", "I keep getting verification codes and sales calls on this number", "searching my name turns up posts from ten years ago", "I'm changing my phone number, which accounts do I need to update first", "I want to clean up my online traces before a job hunt", or hands over an account list or password-manager export and asks to sort it out. Capabilities: (1) three intake paths - self-check tool output, a hand-filled list, or a password-manager export - normalised into one table (2) risk scoring from site category, real-name status, phone binding and public visibility (3) four tiers instead of "delete everything" - delete now, reduce exposure, rebind and decouple, keep and watch (4) per-item prerequisites so you don't lock yourself out: unbind payments, withdraw balances, export files, check OAuth logins (5) mailboxes flagged as recovery anchors - harden, never delete (6) masked report plus a JSON ledger; re-run after 30 days to diff what is gone, unmoved or new. Do not trigger for: investigating someone else's accounts, people-search or due diligence on a person, scraping non-public data, legal evidence collection, corporate asset inventory (different compliance regime), or plain disk cleanup (use mac-space-cleanup).
